testcase.name: Scenario: Keep ribbon key tips visible while arrow keys change the model view: home/vmiguel/git/oblikovati-workspace/oblikovati-rust/target/benchmarks/mcad-scenarios-35f4a77b/features/application/ribbon-keyboard-navigation/ribbon-keyboard-navigation.feature:192:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Keep ribbon key tips visible while arrow keys change the model view ✔ Given a part with a visible solid is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full 3D Model ribbon is selected ✔ When the user presses Alt to show top-level ribbon key tips ✔ And the user presses the Right Arrow key ✔ Then the displayed solid changes orientation ✔ And the top-level ribbon key tips remain visible ✔ When the user presses the Left Arrow key ✔ Then the solid returns to its prior visible orientation ✔ And the top-level ribbon key tips remain visible ✔ When the user presses the 3D Model tab key tip ✔ Then the ribbon shows command-level key tips ✔ When the user presses Alt ✔ Then the key tips disappear
